title: [Main] - Posting from Released production order affects Firm planned production order with same ID.
summary: A status check was added to prevent Firm Planned production orders from incorrectly reading capacity ledger entries of same-numbered Released orders, which was causing their allocated capacity to be miscalculated.
key_points: Added status guard in CalcActuallyPostedCapacityTime that returns 0 for non-Released/Finished statuses
Prevents Firm Planned, Planned, and Simulated orders from reading capacity ledger entries
Ensures allocated capacity for Firm Planned orders is calculated correctly as full needed time
Fixes data corruption where allocated time was wrongly reduced by another order's posted capacity
Test coverage added for the capacity requirements scenario
quote: Added a status guard at the top of CalcActuallyPostedCapacityTime that returns 0 when the routing line's Status is not Released or Finished.
